sources.entry: Keyframes Player - Simple macOS app to preview animations created with Facebook's keyframes framework.

summary.one_liner: A simple macOS app for previewing animations built with Facebook's Keyframes framework, with an option to export them as Core Animation archives (.caar).
summary.what_it_does: The app opens and previews animations created with Facebook's Keyframes framework. It can export those animations to Core Animation archive files (.caar), which are trees of CALayer objects encoded with NSKeyedArchiver. The README says these archives can be loaded in AppKit or UIKit apps later, so the Keyframes framework does not need to ship with the app. The export path is aimed at After Effects animations that Keyframes reconstructs with Core Animation. The README gives Objective-C and Swift snippets for reading an exported file. It also points to CAAR Player on macOS as a way to check that an export worked.
use_cases: preview After Effects animations on macOS
export animations to Core Animation archives
use After Effects animations in an iOS or macOS app without extra dependencies
check that a keyframes export is valid
load exported .caar files in AppKit or UIKit
how_to_run: Download the latest release from the Releases page (README link)
notable: Exports Keyframes animations to .caar Core Animation archives
Exported archives load without shipping the Keyframes framework
Companion CAAR Player on macOS for inspecting exports
Includes Objective-C and Swift loading snippets in the README
caveats: README says not all Keyframes features work with the archive export; it has been tested mainly on common shape and transform animations
Setup is download-only in the README; no build instructions are given
Platform is macOS for the player app
